HexKagune 1.3.10 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (protocol 59: update both). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, not tried in game.

- Pregnancy: married to Eto, the "us" talk topic has "Let's have a baby." She says yes, and the next night scene, she conceives (always a fade to black, nothing explicit). Only married couples.
- Her belly shows from about a fifth of the way along and swells gently to the end, on her (and on female players: the system is built for them, waiting for a male NPC to marry).
- While she's carrying, "How's the baby?" is always the first thing to talk about (feel the baby, cravings, boy or girl, are you scared), with different lines early, along, late and due. The morning after, she knows.
- You get private alerts as her time goes on (the first kick, she's tired, it's close).
- Two Minecraft days after that night: the birth. If you're within 96 blocks you get a cutscene ("9 months later...", a small cry in the dark, who was born); otherwise an alert to come home.
- Children: the baby appears at her feet, named (soft Japanese names), a boy or a girl. It grows through baby (sits), toddler (day 2), child (day 5) and teen (day 9), each with its own size, health and lines.
- Right-click your child: pick up and put down (baby and toddler, carried on your arm, your arms cradling it; Shift and right-click also puts it down), play, teach it to fight (child and teen, one lesson a day, up to 5), follow me, wait here, and how are you.
- Taught children and teens fight monsters going after their family (a ghoul child's kakugan shows while it fights); untaught ones run to you. Your own hits never land on your child.
- Looks: hair is a blend of both parents' hair colours (yours is read off the top of your skin's head), eyes come from one parent, and skin tone is a blend of both parents' real skin tones (yours is read off your skin's face), so a light-skinned parent's children come out light-skinned.
- A ghoul child if a parent is a ghoul; with a one-eyed parent (Eto is one), a 60% chance of one kakugan instead of two.
- Child skins are built from proper skin parts (girls' long hair styles, boys' short ones, outfits by age: a onesie for babies, play clothes, a teen's clothes), recoloured per child. No beards, never the adult female body.
- If a child dies it comes back home a day later. Children talk to you now and then, and greet you when you come back.
- Testing commands for operators: /kagune family soon (the birth in ten seconds) and /kagune family grow (your nearest child grows a stage).
- Skin parts are from the edit_skin mod (MrRar and others), CC BY-SA 3.0/4.0, credited in textures/entity/child/CREDITS.txt.
